definitions.explanation: A suggested course of action or scheme.
A concept or notion for doing something.
A preliminary version of a document or law.

examples.japanese: いい{案|あん}が{浮|う}かんだ。
examples.english: A good idea came to me.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}{案|あん}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
{法|ほう}{案|あん}が{可決|かけつ}された。

notes:
{案|あん} refers to plans, ideas, or draft documents.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {案|あん}を{出|だ}す (to propose an idea)
- {案|あん}が{浮|う}かぶ (an idea comes to mind)
- {案|あん}を{練|ね}る (to work out a plan)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {法案|ほうあん}: bill (legislation)
- {予算案|よさんあん}: budget proposal
- {企画案|きかくあん}: project proposal
- {代案|だいあん}: alternative plan
- {名案|めいあん}: brilliant idea
